notes.title: New DLC and Free Update Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Free Multiplayer Update[/h2]

You can now deliver [b]together[/b] in the all new [b]co-op mode[/b]. Host a private or public game today and explore what it's like managing a delivery company with a partner. Each player manages their own unique fleet, but resources and company profits are shared. Ping the map to communicate important deliveries and plans with your partner. Work together to complete challenges in any real world city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/532dc1da3ab62f84da3e06f524bf105b3aadc358.png[/img]

[h2]Supporter Pack DLC[/h2]

This optional DLC takes vehicle customization to the next level. In addition to changing the color of your vehicles, you can now change the vehicle's skin and add unique decals with customizable colors. You will also be able to personalize your multiplayer profile by changing your name, font style, and avatar. 

[h3]Purchase the Supporter Pack today and contribute to further development of our games.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025980/Delivery_INC__Supporter_Pack/


Adding multiplayer has been a huge and complex task. [b]If you encounter any problems, please let us know by reporting a bug from the pause menu [/b] so we can start working on a fix ASAP. If you have a more complex issue, we invite you to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/D7hZbNNNFg]Discord[/url] where you can chat directly with the developers. You can also just come hang out and tell us your thoughts on the new content or what you want to see next in Delivery INC!

Enjoy!
- Digifox Team

notes.title: Major Update & Large Cargo DLC Release!
notes.notes:
The “Large Cargo” DLC is available for purchase today and we’ve packed in a major update to go along with it. There is a lot of fresh content to explore for new and old players.

[h2]LARGE CARGO DLC[/h2]

Specialty vehicles, a new delivery type, and brand new campaign awaits you. The Large Cargo DLC gives players a fun and challenging new way to experience delivery management, including 8 new achievements to master. 

Furniture, appliances, and other oddly shaped things need to be delivered. Send vehicles that can accommodate the awkward shapes and make sure your driver is strong enough to handle the heavy cargo. Strategize to speed up cargo deliveries by assigning an assistant driver to help or equipping the appropriate upgrade. Purchase the Large Cargo DLC today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666560/Delivery_INC__Large_Cargo/

[h2]FREE CONTENT UPDATE - Version 1.5.0[/h2]

We’ve been testing new features in the Open Beta for a while now and are happy to announce that they are ready for full release! Thank you to everyone that played the beta versions and provided feedback. The new features are listed below:

[list]
[*] New upgrade “Refrigerated Trunk” will give extra time to deliver cold food deals and less time to deliver hot food deals

[*] Employees can now be leveled up to level 25. Each level will give the option for a new reward for that employee. Experience points are earned by completing deliveries. If an assistant is assigned to a vehicle, they will receive some of the experience points for deliveries they help with

[*] Every Free Play city has a trophy that can be earned for completing all 20 free play challenges

[*] The unlock case has been updated adding more items that can be unlocked. Check the unlocks case in the main menu to see all unlocks.

[*] An “idle vehicle” button has been added to quickly select a vehicle in need of instructions.

[*] Deliveries that have only been partially picked up are now more clearly marked on the map

[*] Upon completing a city campaign, you will now have the option to continue playing in free play mode keeping all company progress made
[/list]
[h2]Co-op Entering Open Beta Soon[/h2]

Want to try to play Delivery INC with a friend? A new update to the Open Beta branch is on the way that will let you do just that! If you are interested in more information, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/D7hZbNNNFg]Discord [/url]for updates on when it will be available.

For those that are interested, a full list of patch notes can be found below. Thanks for all of your support! More DLC and free updates are in progress.
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Delivery Managers![/h1]
This update is a big one that we’ve been eager to get out. A lot of improvements are here for performance and quality of life as well as new game features and vehicles. We hope you enjoy the update!

[h2]DELIVERY INC - Patch Notes 1.0.7[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added challenges to Free Play. This feature adds an alternative way to unlock campaign rewards.
[*]Added two new vehicles. The EV car and EV SUV are now available in the game. They can be unlocked in the Beijing campaign instead of the rickshaw and auto rickshaw. The rickshaw vehicles are still in the game and have been unlocked in free play for all players.
[*]Fixed an issue where the multi-route feature would sometimes skip the first destination in the queue.
[*]More optimization added to prevent lag while 3D buildings are enabled.
[*]Fixed positioning of “days owned” tooltip for vehicles.
[*]Vehicles in the maintenance tab will now automatically be moved to the bottom of the list after all normal and severe repairs are made.
[*]The maintenance tab will no longer continue flashing red after repairs are made.
[*]Fixed a rare issue where canceling a severe repair would not work.
[*]Updated location of where map data is stored on the user's computer. Map data is now stored in the same location as the game and when the game is uninstalled, all map data will be removed with the game.
[*]More optimization added to searching and downloading custom cities in free play.
[*]A warning will now be displayed during gameplay if you are in danger of going bankrupt.
[*]Minor Russian translation improvements.
[*]Minor Chinese translation improvements.
[*]Fixed minor text issues.
[*]Redesigned main menu and pause menu for better player readability.
[*]The summary screen now shows the exact number of excellent, good, bad and ignored reviews.
[*]A HEX value can now be used to select the color of your vehicles.
[*]Fixed an issue where vehicles that could not rush still showed visual indicators as if they could rush. Note that drivers with the reckless trait will rush on ANY vehicle.
[/list]
If you experience any problems during gameplay, please report a bug from the pause menu or main menu. You can also join our discord to speak directly with us.

Thanks for playing!
- DigiFox Team

notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Delivery Managers![/h1]
We’ve got another patch ready for you bringing solutions for many of the problems being reported. More stability improvements are here along with major updates to our map system. Thank you for your reports and your patience as we find solutions to your problems. We hope this new update helps!

We are preparing a [b]Road Map[/b] for our players, we will reveal it next week. Quality-of-life updates as well as an improved Free Play mode is on the way.

[h2][b]DELIVERY INC - Patch Notes 1.0.5[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated map system. Searching, downloading, and generating maps is more reliable and hopefully faster. We have another map update in the works that will resolve even more issues.
[*] Reworked balancing of SMS situation spawner. Harsher situations will appear less often than others. We will continue working on this feature to improve it even further in future updates.
[*] Reworked system for employees with prior work experience. Spawning events at the start of each day should be much less frequent. The frequency can also be adjusted to your liking with the “situations per day” setting in free play.
[*] More stability improvements for larger maps.
[*] Fixed issues with standard maps in free play mode.
[*] [b]Added more vehicles to the vehicle finder in Free Play mode.[/b]
[*] Added “Report A Bug” button on the title screen.
[*] Added error messages to map loading/search menus.
[*] Improved translations and fixed typos.
[*] Fixed minor issues with the commission trait.
[*] Added “Vehicle License” page in Tips and Tricks menu.
[*] Made improvements to the gameplay camera.
[*] Fixed minor graphical issues.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]
If you experience any issues during gameplay, please report a bug from the pause menu or main menu. You can also join our discord to speak directly with us.

Thank you!
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Delivery Managers![/h1]
Thank you all so much for playing Delivery INC in ways we couldn’t even imagine. Our main focus has been put toward improving the stability of the game to get rid of lag issues. This new patch is going to make a smoother experience for many.

[h2]DELIVERY INC - Patch Notes 1.0.4[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made major improvements to deal spawning logic to prevent lag.
[*] Made major improvements to cops roaming logic to prevent lag.
[*] Made changes to prevent lag during gameplay after loading a save file with several days played.
[*] We’ve made more improvements to situation spawning in free-play mode.
[*] Free-play mode “situation frequency” slider now has more options to tune the game to your liking.
[*] Added an additional option in free-play mode to generate maps with or without unpaved roads. Generating maps with only paved roads will give a more realistic delivery experience.
[*] Fixed an issue with the camera not working properly during map expansion tile selection.
[/list]
If you experience any issues during gameplay, please report a bug from the pause menu.

Our next focus is to help those of you that have issues loading/downloading maps. We are also reworking the frequency of employees with prior work experience offering special deliveries at the start of each day. The next patch is in the works. Stay tuned!

Thank you!
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello Delivery Managers![/h1][/b]
We’ve been reading through all of the bug reports and suggestions. This new patch will address several complaints and hopefully make your play experience even better. Thank you so much to everyone reporting these issues!

[b][h2]DELIVERY INC - Patch Notes 1.0.3[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with random SMS situation spawning system in free play mode.
[*] SMS situations in free play have a much longer delay before they can happen again.
[*] Decreased the chance for vehicles to gain faults and decreased the maximum number of faults vehicles can have.
[*] Improved police roaming so police do not get stuck in sections of the map.
[*] Fixed a graphical issue where vehicles and deals appear very small until moving/zooming the camera.
[*] The final New York event as well as a few other events will now automatically delete and remove all undelivered deals once the event ends. This small change has been made to prevent game-breaking issues.
[*] Adjusted job advertisements. Selecting a specific license type as a requirement now has a much higher chance to spawn drivers with that license type.
[*] Fixed graphical issues with the luxury status not returning to a luxury vehicle after fixing the “dents & dings” fault.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that occurs on checkpoint deals where one of the checkpoints could not be completed.
[*] Fixed an issue in the “situations per day” setting in free play. After map expansion, the situations per day setting is no longer reset to 2.
[/list]

If you experience any issues during gameplay, please report a bug from the pause menu.

Thank you!
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Hello Delivery Managers![/h2][/b]
We’ve been reading through all of the bug reports and suggestions. This new patch will address several complaints and hopefully make your play experience even better. Thank you so much to everyone reporting these issues! Another patch is already in the works.

[h2][b]DELIVERY INC - v1.0.2 Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Massive FPS improvements for map expansion. Players should have a much more enjoyable experience with larger maps.[/b]
[*] Added the ability to disable 3D buildings in the settings menu. If you are still having FPS issues after map expansion, please try disabling the 3D buildings option in settings. Disabling 3D buildings will also speed up map generation for those that are having issues with long loading times.
[*] A skip button has been added to the map expansion for players that do not want to expand the map or for those players that still have FPS issues with larger maps.
[*] End-of-day logic has been improved. If the day timer is fully depleted and all active deliveries have no delivery time remaining, the day will instantly end.
[*] [b]Bicycles now always use the “rushing” route and no longer have the option to rush. However, “reckless” drivers will still auto-enable rushing and can be pulled over while on bicycles.[/b]
[*] Fixed a game-breaking issue with the “carjacking” SMS situation.
[*] Deals that are involved in a vehicle’s SMS situation can no longer be picked up by other vehicles. This will fix many issues with the day never ending for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue in the New York final event that sometimes caused the day to never end.
[*] Fixed a game-breaking issue with the “restaurant out of order” SMS situation that sometimes caused the day to never end.
[*] [b]In free-play, you can now select how many SMS situations you will encounter each day.[/b]
[*] Fixed minor translation issues.
[*] Improved the bug reporter to send more logs to our developers so we can fix reported bugs faster.
[/list]
We are aware that there is an issue with the luxury status being restored after it is lost due to a vehicle fault. A fix for this will be out as soon as possible.

We are aware that vehicles sometimes do not auto pick up or drop off deliveries. We have implemented a fix for some of these cases, but it may not fix all of them.

If you experience any issues during gameplay, especially the ones mentioned above, please report a bug from the pause menu.

Thank you!
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Campaign Reveal - Developer Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Campaign Reveal - Developer Update[/h3]
The Delivery INC campaign has been in development for the last few months. We are excited to show you a peek into the campaign mode for Delivery INC, a journey through different cities with unlockables, challenges, and exciting stories.

[h3]Campaign Overview[/h3]
Each campaign city has a reason for your arrival. New York is struggling with an influx of visitors because of the Times Square New Year’s Eve event and the mayor needs your help. Mr. Ramsay is starting a ghost kitchen in London to get into the lucrative food delivery business. He needs a talented delivery manager on his team and he’s chosen you for the job. Each city has unique characters that are requesting your delivery management skills. Some cities are available from the start and more can be unlocked by earning stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/72235c14122fa4c0acc9881b116c7be02cd28b73.png[/img]

Earning these stars is no easy task. Each campaign has challenges that you must complete to earn stars. Earn enough stars and you will unlock new rewards. It’s not just about unlocking the next city. You’ll also earn other rewards like new vehicles, upgrades, restrictions and more along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/f5c1a222d76032b61dba1662cd0996605bd32a83.gif[/img]

Restrictions are special rewards for the most hardcore players. Restrictions are optional game settings in Free Play mode that increase the difficulty level. For example, the “Extra Police” restriction adds more cops on the map. The “Faulty Vehicles” restriction, makes vehicles gain faults far more frequently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/8cb53a2c2c2ee802a593f5839a6fd3b559c58858.png[/img]

Each campaign city has one of these restrictions enabled. If you can complete every challenge for a city in a single playthrough, you will unlock that cities’ restriction in Free Play mode. You can also try to get 5 platinum stars if you’re a REALLY hardcore player, but we will let you figure out how to achieve that.

[h3]Watch the Campaign on YouTube[/h3]
We are currently collaborating with YouTubers to give you an early look at Delivery INC. Orbital Potato and Dad's Gaming Addiction have videos uploaded sharing a sneak peek into the game’s campaign mode. Click the links below to watch their videos.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MiTxyDEWNm0 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=plF9RPQt5OM 
If you are a content creator interested in trying an early build of Delivery INC, feel free to reach out to us.

[h3]Get Involved![/h3]
Don’t miss your chance to chat directly with the developers and give us your feedback. Let us know what you think about the campaign! Your input will help us improve the game and give the best delivery management experience to our players.

Join our Discord now and start sharing your thoughts.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/D7hZbNNNFg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/24040c0fa9debeb575b6206f8cdd8b49ecd927f9.png[/img][/url]


If you haven’t wishlisted Delivery INC yet, click the wishlist button now and click follow so you don’t miss more updates like this one.

notes.title: Post Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Steam Next Fest: Delivery Complete![/h2]
It has been almost a month now since the Steam Next Fest. As many of you know, we had a demo available during the festival. We were thrilled to see so many of you downloading and trying the demo! Since then, we’ve been hard at work reviewing the feedback, survey responses, and bug reports.

[h2]Survey Results[/h2]
The Delivery INC Demo was [b]rated 8.2 out of 10![/b] Thanks to the helpful feedback provided from the community, we are confident that we will raise that rating even higher.

[b]92% of players reported that the game difficulty was just right.[/b] We designed Delivery INC with the goal of creating a challenging yet enjoyable experience, and these findings suggest that we have succeeded in achieving that balance.

[b]83% would recommend the game to their friends.[/b]  This is great to hear because we are working on adding a co-op option to Delivery INC. Soon you will be able to play with the friends you recommend the game to.

[h2]Feedback & Features[/h2]

[h3]Improvements to Vehicle Damage[/h3]
In the demo, vehicles could have “permanent damage” where some of the faults were unrepairable. After hearing your feedback, we are changing this feature to “severe damage” instead. These damages will be repairable now, but you will have to send the vehicle off for repairs making it unavailable for a day or two.

[h3]When is the game launching on Steam?[/h3]
The project has officially been greenlit to be published as soon as possible! Over the next few months, our main focus will be working on the game’s single player campaign as well as the additional features mentioned above. We will share progress with you as we go and announce a release date as soon as we can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/f8f2e0fa4a859080afb5235a072565956fabe77e.png[/img]

Thanks again to everyone that played the demo and provided feedback. As promised, we will be selecting a few of those people randomly and rewarding them with a free copy of the game as soon as it becomes available.[b] If you missed the demo during the Steam Next Fest, please consider joining our Discord! Our members may have more opportunities to play the game early.
[/b]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/D7hZbNNNFg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/24040c0fa9debeb575b6206f8cdd8b49ecd927f9.png[/img][/url]

Cheers! 
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Delivery INC - Developer Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Your Delivery Has Arrived![/h2]

Digifox here! We launched Transport INC in 2020. Transport INC is about the transportation business on a large scale where you’re responsible for transporting people and cargo from city to city and even country to country. We’ve teamed up with Games Operators again to bring a new transportation idea to life. In Delivery INC, we’re zooming way in to explore the delivery business on a much smaller scale. This means you’ll be getting a much more personal experience with your customers and staff. Delivery INC has been in development for a while now and we are excited to finally share our progress with you.
[h2]
Progress Update[/h2]

Right now, we are just finishing up the Alpha phase of development. Almost all of the core mechanics are in place. We’ve also been busy doing a graphics overhaul to make the game look as good as it can. Check how the visuals of the game have changed in the last few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/d07872f086dd27500633bcae78a2a6c6352fafce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/b2a5c60b09beed3a622fc76f63a97eb648a94984.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/4b4835946b265f8d7f0f8af66ad984fcfbaa3101.png[/img]
[h2]Gameplay Overview Trailer[/h2]

We’ve prepared a video diving deeper into some of the game mechanics of Delivery INC. All footage is 100% gameplay. You’re seeing the game as it looks and plays today, but keep in mind that it’s still a work in progress. We are always making improvements and there are even more features being added.

[previewyoutube=p3XEtlt9Fcw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Get Involved![/h2]


The Digifox Discord now has a section dedicated to Delivery INC. You can join today to ask any question you might have and even participate in contests to get your ideas into the game!  In Delivery INC, customers leave short reviews based on their experience. Some reviews are serious while others are funny. If you were the customer, what review would you leave? Once per week, we will give a delivery scenario in our Discord giving you a chance to write a short customer review. We will read all submitted reviews and pick some of our favorites. If your customer review is chosen, it will be added to the game. Not only that, but we will also include your name in the game's credits! We can't wait to read the amazing customer reviews our community writes. Thanks for getting involved and supporting Delivery INC. Good luck!

[url=https://discord.gg/D7hZbNNNFg ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/24040c0fa9debeb575b6206f8cdd8b49ecd927f9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Play The Demo[/h2]

Our next goal is to release a public demo so you can get a hands-on experience of Delivery INC. If you are interested in playing the demo, be sure to click the follow button in the Delivery INC Steam News Hub. You’ll be notified by email as soon as the Demo is available.
[b]
That’s all for now! Please leave your feedback and suggestions in the comments. We can’t wait to hear what you think about Delivery INC.[/b]
